news.headline: US Markets Rally Sharply — S&P +1.06%, Nasdaq +1.40%, Dow +1.18%
news.what_happened: All three major US indices posted strong gains on Sep 3, led by tech stocks. Best single-day performance since August.
news.why_it_matters: Strong US rally signals global risk-on. FII flows into India likely to continue. Indian IT stocks track Nasdaq closely for valuation re-rating.

news.headline: Hang Seng Surges +2.10% on China Stimulus Expectations
news.what_happened: Hong Kong's Hang Seng index jumped over 2% as traders bet on additional fiscal and monetary stimulus from Beijing despite China's factory PMI contracting for 2nd consecutive month.
news.why_it_matters: Hang Seng rally signals metals demand expectations for China recovery. Indian metal stocks get a direct boost from China demand outlook.

news.headline: US 10-Year Yield Falls 3.4 bps to 4.762% on Eased Fed Hike Bets
news.what_happened: US 10Y Treasury yield declined from 4.796% to 4.762% after Fed Governor Waller signalled support for rate hold if inflation continues easing.
news.why_it_matters: Falling US yields reduce risk premium on emerging markets, supporting FII inflows into India. Rate-sensitive sectors (banks, NBFCs, real estate) benefit from bond portfolio gains.

news.headline: India Q1 FY27 GDP at 7.8% — Private Investment Revival Signals
news.what_happened: India's economy grew 7.8% in April-June 2026 quarter, beating estimates, with early signs of private investment revival broadening growth engines.
news.why_it_matters: Strong GDP reinforces India macro story, supporting banking credit growth, capital goods capex, and consumer discretionary. Positive for overall market confidence.

news.headline: RBI Holds Repo at 5.25%; FCNR Deposit Drive Raises Record $127 Billion
news.what_happened: RBI kept repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with neutral stance. India's FCNR-B diaspora deposit program attracted a record $127bn, bolstering rupee and forex reserves.
news.why_it_matters: Rate hold is neutral for banks near-term. FCNR success signals RBI's rupee management strength. Rupee at 2-month high supports import-oriented sectors and curbs fuel-driven inflation.

picks.logic: Infosys earns ~98% of revenues in foreign currencies. Nasdaq +1.40% is a direct IT sector valuation re-rating trigger. After 4 consecutive sessions of market weakness, INFY sits near Rs1,140 support. Risk-reward improves after the pullback — strong global cue + mean reversion play.

picks.catalyst: S&P 500 +1.06%, US 10Y yield -3.4bps, FII net buyers Rs6,688Cr (Sep 2)
picks.logic: HDFCBANK has the highest FII ownership among Indian private banks. S&P +1.06% + falling US yields = FII buying in India's most liquid bank stock. India GDP 7.8% supports credit growth and NII outlook for Q2 FY27.
